_meta.notes: Spores: the earned currency the shop prices in. Earned by consuming dung (a world drop), by acquiring a mutation, and by being credited with a kill. Spent in the shop; the server checks the balance, so the client can never spend more than it has. Persistence of the purse across restarts is still T08A.

starting_balance.notes: Spores a new plant starts with. Enough for the cheapest two items, so the shop can be tried on the first session without a grind.

earn_dung.notes: Spores for consuming one dung item. Dung is a death/fauna drop, so this is the reward for using what the world leaves behind.

earn_fragment.notes: Spores for picking up one fragment drop. Fragments have no item definition, so the reward is currency: the plant broke, and the pieces are worth something.

earn_mutation.notes: Spores for acquiring a mutation. Mutations are the plant's own luck; the currency pays for the moments it happens.

earn_kill.notes: Spores credited to the killer when another plant dies inside the kill-credit window.

max_balance.notes: Ceiling on a balance. One bug cannot produce a runaway purse.
